user.title: Add a Govee BLE air purifier
user.description: Choose a purifier currently visible to a connectable Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter or proxy. Near is the device with the strongest current signal. Close the Govee app first because the purifier accepts only one Bluetooth connection. Weak-signal setup can continue retrying for up to five minutes.

data_description.address: Select the purifier you want Home Assistant to configure.

enable_custom_auto.title: Enable Custom Auto
enable_custom_auto.description: Custom Auto uses PM2.5 readings to select the purifier's fan level. It is disabled by default and can be enabled later in the integration settings.

custom_auto_settings.title: Custom Auto settings
custom_auto_settings.description: Set the PM2.5 boundaries and the time required before Custom Auto changes fan levels.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to and initialize the purifier. Make sure it is powered on, in Bluetooth range, and not connected to the Govee app.
error.not_discovered: Home Assistant cannot currently see this purifier from a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.boundaries_not_ascending: PM2.5 boundaries must increase from Sleep to Turbo.
error.invalid_integer: Enter whole numbers for all Custom Auto settings.
error.value_out_of_range: One or more Custom Auto values are outside the allowed range.
error.invalid_custom_auto_settings: The Custom Auto settings are invalid.
error.stored_options_invalid: The saved Custom Auto settings are invalid. Disable Custom Auto or enable it and save a complete replacement configuration.

abort.model_profile_invalid: The bundled purifier model profiles are invalid. Reinstall or update the integration, restart Home Assistant, and try again.
abort.devices_seen_without_supported_name: Home Assistant received fresh Bluetooth advertisements, but none included or retained a supported Govee H7124 or H7129 purifier name. Move the purifier or Bluetooth proxy closer, close the Govee app, and try Add device again.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Govee H7124 or H7129 air purifiers were seen during the Bluetooth scan. Make sure the purifier is powered on, in range, and disconnected from the Govee app.

communication_failed.message: The purifier did not confirm the command before the Bluetooth operation timed out.
